   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  FEBRUARY 10, 2025

Chair Leon called the meeting to order at 5:59 p.m. Responding to roll call were Vice Chair Ang and
Commissioner Sanchez. Also present was Levy Sun, Director of Communications & Public Affairs and
Alex Ocegueda, Office Assistant III.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Chair Leon made the motion and Commissioner Ang seconded to approve the minutes for January 10,
2024. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

Holiday Décor / Home and Business Beautification Contest

Mrs. Ocegueda informed the Commission that the Home & Business Beautification contest submission
period is during March with judging scheduled to take place at their April meeting. Mrs. Ocegueda
asked the Commission if they would like to remove the contest awards from a City Council meeting to
staff delivery with available Commissioners to join and if they still wish to provide winners with a yard
sign. Commissioners agreed to have staff deliver the awards for both the Holiday Décor and
Beautification contests and continue providing the yard signs. Mrs. Ocegueda reported the top three
(3) home décor winners and top two (2) business décor winners.

Commissioners Meet and Greet Dinner

Mrs. Ocegueda asked Commissioners to confirm a theme for the event. Commissioners all agreed to
a Hawaiian Theme. Mrs. Ocegueda stated she would reach out to the Recreation Department to see
what Hawaiian décor they have that could be used for the event. Chair Leon instructed the
Commissioners to think of product/design ideas for the party favors.

Business Spotlight

Mr. Sun showed the “Keeping It Norwalk” Campaign, the January Hot Drink Spots edition video to
Commissioners. Commissioners praised staff on the new reel format being used for the Business
Spotlight.

Communications and Public Affairs Analytics

Mr. Sun provided the analytics and explained Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and the city’s overall
reach across all outreach platforms for the last month showing an increase in key metrics.

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Vice Chair Ang asked about merchandising. Mr. Sun reported that the next step is to survey the
community about what they would like to buy and what cultural icon they would want on the design.
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Community Promotion Commission
February 10, 2025

Mrs. Ocegueda informed the Commission of a new date for the Egg-stravagant event and provided
other community event dates. Commissioners agreed to conduct the first survey at Artastic. Mr. Sun
will draft questions for Commissioners’ review at the March meeting. Chair Leon reported positive
outcome about the Lions Club Food Distribution event she volunteered for in January.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

Brian Tindel spoke about his role in advocating for native trees. He’s requesting that the Commission
create a new award for sustainable yards that use native plants to encourage residents to do their part.
Vice Chair Ang requested staff to research the city ordinance about the legality of converting yards to
native vegetation.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 6:58 p.m.

_____________________________

Armida Leon, Chair
Community Promotion Commission
